Taylor (Marketing): Planning to announce Thurs 2026-07-08 09:00 PT. Need final changelog one-liner + two bullets, docs anchor, and webinar RSVP. Can eng confirm canary plan and a short hero stat? :sparkles:
Omar (Eng): We can do it. Model variant to call out: rwd-infer-v2-large. Bench snapshot: p50 gen 72ms -> 88ms prior, p95 305ms -> 390ms prior. Token cost down ~9%. Will this support a ~20% hero stat?
Taylor (Marketing): We'll use conservative phrasing: "~20% latency improvement on common prompts, plus lower per-token costs." Need eng sign-off on wording and the exact model string.
Omar (Eng): Signed off on wording. Confirmed model: rwd-infer-v2-large (bf16, no quantization). Staged rollout recommended: 7% T+0, 30% T+25m, 75% T+90m, 100% T+4h.
Clara (Docs): I'll prep /docs/release-2026-07-08 with anchor /docs/release-2026-07-08#notes. Adding migration note for Dedicated customers and a short FAQ. ETA tomorrow morning.
Hana (Growth): RSVP (staging): https://events.redwood.ai/launch-jul?utm_campaign=july_launch&utm_source=email. I'll swap to prod once Clara posts final doc URL. Need 1-line speaker blurb and CTA.
Vik (Ops): Ops OK on ramp. Rollback triggers: error rate >1% for 5m OR sustained p95 >2.5x baseline for 15m. I'll add the runbook and contact list. We'll monitor metrics in #eng-sre and tag this thread if anything happens.
Taylor (Marketing): Draft changelog one-liner: "Routing improvements and KV-cache fixes to improve latency and reduce per-token cost for hosted inference." Draft bullets: "Smarter routing lowers average token latency by ~20%" and "KV-cache fixes improve cold-cache tail latency and reduce compute spend." Approve?
Omar (Eng): Approve the changelog text. Please include exact model and precision: "rwd-infer-v2-large (bf16)" in the docs and blog. I'll add the final commit to the changelog PR by 16:00 PT.
notify-bot: Canary scheduled: 7% -> 1777771834 (T+8m), 30% -> 1777773334 (T+35m), 75% -> 1777777234 (T+90m), 100% -> 1777785434 (T+4h). Automated healthchecks enabled. :robot_face:
Hana (Growth): Speaker blurb: "Join Redwood engineers for a live demo of lower-latency inference and the new routing controls." CTA: "Reserve your seat — space is limited."
Clara (Docs): Added migration note: "No customer action required; Dedicated customers can opt into advanced routing flags." Will post final doc URL here when ready. ETA AM.
notes: This thread coordinates marketing + eng for a release announcement: changelog, docs, webinar, canary schedule, rollback gates. No title per Slack thread rules.
